tagline: A free design studio for architects and students
headline: From first idea
to final sheet.
intro: ArchHub is a free design studio in your browser. Plan a concept, draw accurate floor plans, and build towards a portfolio, without installing anything.

flow.title: Concept
flow.description: Brief, site study, inspiration and a first sketch.

flow.title: Floor plans
flow.description: Walls, curves, floors, layers and dimensions at true scale.

flow.title: Elevations
flow.description: Drawn automatically from your plans and wall heights.

flow.title: Sections
flow.description: Cut anywhere through the plan, with slabs, plinth and footings.

flow.title: 3D views
flow.description: Orbit the outside or walk through the inside, with sun and shadows.

flow.title: Portfolio
flow.description: Lay out sheets and export a PDF.

sections.title: Studio Tools
sections.description: Small calculators and helpers for everyday studio work.

items.title: Concept Planner
items.description: Go from brief, site and climate to a form inspired by an object or idea, a concept sketch and a statement, in six guided steps.

items.title: Scale Converter
items.description: Convert between real size and drawing size at 1:50, 1:100, 1:200, 1:500 or any custom scale.

items.title: Area Calculator
items.description: Work out room and site areas in square metres and square feet.

items.title: Floor Plan Studio
items.description: Draw accurate plans with walls, doors, windows, furniture, dimensions and room areas. Export PNG and DXF.
